technical.summary: Oversold conditions present but undermined by bearish crossovers, price below all key moving averages, and lack of trend conviction; high-risk bounce setup with poor confluence.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 45 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite recent congressional selling by senior members; lack of news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (413.44) with flat yield curve and imminent FOMC event in 2 days creates severe macro headwinds; earnings in 45 days adds moderate event risk but is secondary to acute volatility environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI-9, Williams %R) combined with contrarian extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and supertrend bullish signal create a technical bounce setup near support at 53.28.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish technical structure (death cross, price below all major MAs, MACD crossover down, Ichimoku below cloud, three black crows) combined with zero fundamental conviction, crisis-level VIX (413.44), imminent FOMC event in 2 days, and lack of smart money accumulation make this a high-risk trap bounce with poor risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold technicals (RSI-9, Williams %R) and extreme fear sentiment create a contrarian bounce setup, but this is undermined by bearish structure (death cross, price below all MAs, MACD down) and zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (413.44) and imminent FOMC event in 2 days create acute macro headwinds that could trigger further capitulation; bounce trap risk is high with poor confluence.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on high risk, weak entry quality, and bear dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 3 positions open in Industrials sector; adding AOS increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment without offsetting fundamental or smart money support.
